info.title: Eduskunta Public API for Copilot Studio
info.description: Read-only subset of the Parliament of Finland Public API for parliamentary matters, documents, members, searches and plenary votes.

get.description: Connectivity smoke test and current reference data for parliamentary matter type codes.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

post.description: Search one Eduskunta category with text, structured filters, sorting and pagination. Use CountParliamentData when only a count is needed.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Search request containing category, optional query, expression, pagination and sorting.

200.description: Search results and searchMetadata with total and page counts.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

post.description: Count matches for one Eduskunta category and structured expression without retrieving every result page.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Count request containing category and optional query and expression.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.description: Get structured details, stages, status and document relationships for one exact parliamentary matter identifier.

parameters.name: eduskuntatunnus
parameters.description: Exact identifier in normal form, for example HE 60/2018 vp.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.summary: Get documents for a parliamentary matter
get.description: List document metadata connected to one exact parliamentary matter identifier.

parameters.name: eduskuntatunnus
parameters.description: Exact identifier in normal form, for example HE 60/2018 vp.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.description: Get metadata and relationships for one exact EDK document identifier.

parameters.name: edktunnus
parameters.description: Exact EDK identifier, for example EDK-2019-AK-243347.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.description: Get the authoritative HTML text for one exact EDK document identifier. Use this to verify content claims rather than relying on titles.

parameters.name: edktunnus
parameters.description: Exact EDK identifier, for example EDK-2019-AK-243347.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.description: Get one person's details and time-bounded parliamentary, group, constituency, committee and government memberships.

parameters.name: henkilonro
parameters.description: Verified henkilonro value obtained from a search result. Never guess this value.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.summary: Get votes for a parliamentary matter
get.description: List plenary votes connected to one exact parliamentary matter identifier.

parameters.name: eduskuntatunnus
parameters.description: Exact identifier in normal form, for example KAA 1/2019 vp.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.description: Get the question, totals, validity and individual Member votes for one exact vote identifier.

parameters.name: aanestystunnus
parameters.description: Exact vote id returned by GetMatterVotes or GetSessionVotes, for example 2020-141-2.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

get.summary: Get votes for a plenary session
get.description: List all votes connected to one exact plenary session identifier.

parameters.name: istuntotunnus
parameters.description: Exact session id used by the vote API, for example 2020-141. Do not use the PTK document identifier here.

200.description: Votes associated with the plenary session.

default.description: The API or connector returned an error.

query.description: Optional fuzzy full-text query. Prefer structured expression filters for exact constraints.

langCode.description: Optional language code such as fi or sv.

maxResults.description: Maximum results requested for one page.

expression.description: Structured expression using and, or, not, property, match, match_phrase, ranges, exists, with or ids.

sort.description: Optional sort definitions with property and ascending fields.

JsonObject.description: JSON response whose detailed shape is defined by the official Eduskunta OpenAPI specification.
